dynamicTexts: Turning raw data into action plans

sectionLede.education: Academic background and areas of study.

summary.text: Operations specialist focused on building self-sustaining systems: automated reporting pipelines, standardized SOPs, and coordination frameworks that hold under pressure. At Home Digital Indonesia, redesigned the weekly reporting workflow in Excel, returning 12+ hours per week to the team by eliminating manual data handling. Previously led a 34-member student council across 10 divisions, implementing KPI tracking and weekly check-ins to drive accountability and measurable output. Currently pursuing a Data Science degree at Universitas Terbuka, strengthening a data-driven approach to process design and operational decision-making.

details: Redesigned daily sprint dashboards from the ground up, enabling each segment to access real-time performance data without manual compilation.
Overhauled the Call Frequency Management (CFM) system across all 31 depots in West Java, replacing inconsistent processes with a standardized framework suited to field operations.
Built a consolidated analytics dashboard for the Route-to-Market (RTM) division, unifying outlet and segment data across the entire depot network into a single view.
Developed automated Excel reports that eliminated approximately 12 hours of manual data entry per week.
Authored unified SOPs for Finance, Sales, and Operations, replacing fragmented department-level practices with consistent cross-functional standards.
Analyzed internal feedback data to identify process bottlenecks, translating findings into actionable proposals that were adopted by management.
Conducted scheduled inspections and maintenance of all safety equipment, including ropes, harnesses, and carabiners.
Served as lead climber and belayer during technical rescue training exercises.
Delivered hands-on instruction and administered proficiency assessments for incoming trainees.
Led a 34-member council across 10 divisions, introducing KPI-based performance tracking to establish clear accountability per division.
Designed school-wide programs subsequently adopted as permanent initiatives by the administration.
Led outreach campaigns across 12 feeder schools to increase student engagement and recruitment.
Established weekly inter-division coordination meetings, reducing miscommunication and missed deadlines.
Coordinated backstage operations for events with 1,000+ attendees, managing concurrent lighting, sound, and security logistics.
Reduced segment transition times by implementing standardized crew sequencing protocols.

impact.title: Reporting Automation System
impact.desc: The weekly reporting process at Home Digital involved extensive manual data entry, reformatting, and cross-checking. Redesigned the entire workflow in Excel to run with minimal intervention, returning approximately 12 hours per week to the team.

impact.title: KPI-Based Governance Leadership
impact.desc: Managed a 34-member student council across 10 divisions using KPI-based performance tracking and weekly coordination meetings. Programs developed during this period were adopted by the school administration, and outreach efforts extended to 12 feeder schools.

impact.title: Large-Scale Event Execution
impact.desc: Served as MC for the GEMA Bandung Youth Mass (500+ attendees), coordinating speakers, committees, and technical crew on a unified timeline. Previously managed backstage operations for events with 1,000+ attendees, where precise timing was critical.

details: Served as MC for GEMA Bandung's "Misa Angkatan Muda 2025," maintaining program flow for 500+ Catholic students across Bandung.
Developed the annual program calendar and maintained alignment across all teams and volunteers.
Organized a night gathering (~100 attendees) and a youth worship event (~400 attendees).
Maintained all rescue equipment through scheduled maintenance and safety inspections.
Supported training sessions as lead climber and belayer, providing instruction to incoming trainees.
Built a partnership database documenting previous sponsors, enabling continuity for future committee outreach.
Managed Altar Server scheduling, ensuring adequate coverage for every Mass and equitable rotation.
Organized appreciation events and celebrations to strengthen team cohesion.
